净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Simplify the parent's dual-mechanism (drawdown normalized by returns std multiplied by volatility persistence ratio) to a single core mechanism: drawdown depth normalized by ATR. ATR captures recent true-range volatility more robustly than returns std, and the removal of the persistence ratio halves the number of tunable windows, reducing overfitting risk while preserving the mean-reversion intuit

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 rolling_max：close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：close / rolling_max - 1.0
  3. 计算 high：high.values.astype(float64)
  4. 计算 low：low.values.astype(float64)
  5. 计算 close：close.values.astype(float64)
  6. 计算 atr20：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20)
  7. 计算 atr20：pd.Series(atr20, index=df_copy.index)
  8. 计算 normalized_drawdown：drawdown / atr20
  9. 计算 factor：normalized_drawdown
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

列名含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. ATR(20) — talib.ATR(high, low, close, n) → 平均真实波幅
  2. replace(normalized_drawdown, inf, nan) — replace(...) → 替换值

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_atr_recovery(df): df_copy = df.copy() rolling_max = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max() drawdown = df_copy["str">'close'] / rolling_max - 1.0 high = df_copy["str">'high'].values.astype("str">'float64') low = df_copy["str">'low'].values.astype("str">'float64') close = df_copy["str">'close'].values.astype("str">'float64') atr20 = talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20) atr20 = pd.Series(atr20, index=df_copy.index).replace(0, np.nan) normalized_drawdown = drawdown / atr20 factor = normalized_drawdown.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) factor.name = "factor_drawdown_atr_recovery" "kw">class="kw">return factor
